decisions.reason: As a close-to-core line that gained a dedicated page in 2024 after its 2023 launch, it likely met aspiration levels well enough to justify continued support within the firm's design-led drainage portfolio.
Its continued standalone presentation across 2023 and 2024 suggests performance at or above aspiration levels, and it fits the firm's established capabilities in modern, seamless bathroom drainage.

Because it was only mentioned in 2023 and disappeared from the website in 2024, management would read this as evidence of results below aspiration and reallocate resources to stronger core and development projects.

As a very recent 2024 launch that builds on the firm's existing drainage know-how, it should be retained while results are still uncertain, especially given industry growth and enough organisational slack to continue evaluation.
